lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review basic modal verbs in a practical plan-making conversation.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues make a loose fika or lunch plan around work obligations.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Combining ability, desire, plans, obligation, and permission in short turns.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik try to plan a fika after a meeting, but one person has to do an errand and they adjust the plan politely.

main_focus.name: basic modal verb review
main_focus.description: Use kan, vill, ska, måste, and får in short everyday statements and questions.
model_examples: Vi ska ta kaffe efter lunch.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 6-8 modal clauses total, with each modal appearing only where it fits naturally.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use modal chunks in service of a believable arrangement, not as a list.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker suggests fika or lunch after a meeting.
dialogue_shape.middle: They use different modal verbs to explain availability, preference, permission, and obligation.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a simple adjusted plan.

target_complexity.repetition: spiral Week 2 modal patterns while keeping each turn easy to parse

focus: what plan the speakers are trying to make
